verses.en: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Canta alegremente, ó estéril, que não geravas; grita de prazer com alegre canto, e jubila tu que não tiveste dores de parto; pois mais são os filhos da solitária do que os filhos da casada, diz o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: “Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth; break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who did not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Let your voice be loud in song, O woman without children; make melody and sounds of joy, you who did not give birth: for the children of her who had no husband are more than those of the married wife, says the Lord.

verses.en: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
verses.pt: Aumenta o espaço de tua tenda, e as cortinas de tuas habitações sejam estendidas; não o impeças; alonga tuas cordas, e fixa bem tuas estacas;
verses.en_web: “Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don’t spare: lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes.
verses.en_bbe: Make wide the place of your tent, and let the curtains of your house be stretched out without limit: make your cords long, and your tent-pins strong.

verses.en: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
verses.pt: Porque transbordarás à direita e à esquerda; e tua semente tomará posse das nações, e farão habitar as cidades assoladas.
verses.en_web: For you will spread out on the right hand and on the left; and your offspring will possess the nations, and settle in desolate cities.
verses.en_bbe: For I will make wide your limits on the right hand and on the left; and your seed will take the nations for a heritage, and make the waste towns full of people.

verses.en: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.
verses.pt: Não temas, pois não serás envergonhada; e não te envergonhes, pois não serás humilhada; ao contrário, te esquecerás da vergonha da tua juventude, e não te lembrarás mais da desonra de tua viuvez.
verses.en_web: “Don’t be afraid; for you will not be ashamed. Don’t be confounded; for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget the shame of your youth; and the reproach of your widowhood you shall remember no more.
verses.en_bbe: Have no fear; for you will not be shamed or without hope: you will not be put to shame, for the shame of your earlier days will go out of your memory, and you will no longer keep in mind the sorrows of your widowed years.

verses.en: For thy Maker is thine husband; the LORD of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.
verses.pt: Porque teu marido é o Criador; EU-SOU dos exércitos é o seu nome; e o Santo de Israel é o teu Redentor; ele será chamado: o Deus de toda a terra.
verses.en_web: For your Maker is your husband; Yahweh of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be called the God of the whole earth.
verses.en_bbe: For your Maker is your husband; the Lord of armies is his name: and the Holy One of Israel is he who takes up your cause; he will be named the God of all the earth.

verses.en: For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.
verses.pt: Pois o SENHOR te chamou como mulher abandonada, e triste de espírito; como uma mulher da juventude que havia sido rejeitada, diz o teu Deus.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh has called you as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off,” says your God.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord has made you come back to him, like a wife who has been sent away in grief of spirit; for one may not give up the wife of one's early days.

verses.en: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
verses.pt: Por um curto momento te deixei; porém com grandes misericórdias te recolherei.
verses.en_web: “For a small moment I have forsaken you; but with great mercies will I gather you.
verses.en_bbe: For a short time I gave you up; but with great mercies I will take you back again.

verses.en: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the LORD thy Redeemer.
verses.pt: Num acesso de ira escondi minha face de ti por um momento; porém com bondade eterna terei compaixão de ti, diz o SENHOR teu Redentor.
verses.en_web: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from you for a moment; but with everlasting loving kindness I will have mercy on you,” says Yahweh your Redeemer.
verses.en_bbe: In overflowing wrath my face was veiled from you for a minute, but I will have pity on you for ever, says the Lord who takes up your cause.

verses.en: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.
verses.pt: Porque isto será para mim como as águas de Noé, quando jurei que as águas de Noé não mais passaria sobre a terra; assim jurei, que não me irarei contra ti, nem te repreenderei.
verses.en_web: “For this is like the waters of Noah to me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah will no more go over the earth, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you, nor rebuke you.
verses.en_bbe: For this is like the days of Noah to me: for as I took an oath that the waters of Noah would never again go over the earth, so have I taken an oath that I will not again be angry with you, or say bitter words to you.

verses.en: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
verses.pt: Porque montes se removerão e morros se retirarão, porém minha bondade não se removerá de ti, nem o pacto de minha paz se retirará, diz o SENHOR, que tem compaixão de ti.
verses.en_web: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed; but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says Yahweh who has mercy on you.
verses.en_bbe: For the mountains may be taken away, and the hills be moved out of their places, but my love will not be taken from you, or my agreement of peace broken, says the Lord, who has had mercy on you.

verses.en: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colors, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
verses.pt: Tu, oprimida, afligida por tempestade, e desconsolada: eis que eu porei tuas pedras com ornamentos, e te fundarei sobre safiras.
verses.en_web: “You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your foundations with sapphires.
verses.en_bbe: O troubled one, storm-crushed, uncomforted! see, your stones will be framed in fair colours, and your bases will be sapphires.

verses.en: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.
verses.pt: E farei de rubis as tuas torres; e tuas portas de carbúnculos, e todos os teus limites com pedras preciosas.
verses.en_web: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
verses.en_bbe: I will make your towers of rubies, and your doors of carbuncles, and the wall round you will be of all sorts of beautiful stones.

verses.en: And all thy children shall be taught of the LORD; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
verses.pt: E todos os teus filhos serão ensinados pelo SENHOR; e a paz de teus filhos será abundante.
verses.en_web: All your children will be taught by Yahweh; and your children’s peace will be great.
verses.en_bbe: And all your builders will be made wise by the Lord; and great will be the peace of your children.

verses.en: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.
verses.pt: Com justiça serás firmada; afasta-te da opressão, porque já não temerás; assim como também do assombro, porque este não se aproximará de ti.
verses.en_web: In righteousness you will be established. You will be far from oppression, for you will not be afraid; and far from terror, for it shall not come near you.
verses.en_bbe: All your rights will be made certain to you: have no fear of evil, and destruction will not come near you.

verses.en: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.
verses.pt: Se alguém lutar contra ti,não será por mim; quem lutar contra ti cairá por causa de ti.
verses.en_web: Behold, they may gather together, but not by me. Whoever gathers together against you will fall because of you.
verses.en_bbe: See, they may be moved to war, but not by my authority: all those who come together to make an attack on you, will be broken against you.

verses.en: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.
verses.pt: Eis que fui eu que criei ao ferreiro que assopra as brasas no fogo, e que produz a ferramenta para sua obra; também fui eu que criei ao destruidor, para causar ruína.
verses.en_web: “Behold, I have created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame, and forges a weapon for his work; and I have created the destroyer to destroy.
verses.en_bbe: See, I have made the iron-worker, blowing on the burning coals, and making the instrument of war by his work; and I have made the waster for destruction.

verses.en: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Nenhuma ferramenta preparada contra ti terá sucesso; e toda língua que se levantar contra ti em juízo, tu a condenarás; esta é a herança dos servos do SENHOR; e a justiça deles provém de mim, diz o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of Yahweh’s servants, and their righteousness is of me,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: No instrument of war which is formed against you will be of any use; and every tongue which says evil against you will be judged false. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness comes from me, says the Lord.
